title: Fix bug: Cannot add new processes
description: There is a bug where clicking '+ Add Process' does not create a new node on the canvas. Root cause: after refactoring the graph-store to remove persist middleware and add subscribeWithSelector, the addNode function must work correctly when a stream is loaded. Ensure the addNode action appends to the current nodes array and the new node appears on canvas. Also verify the node palette drag-and-drop path works correctly.
